column3: When used, this citation grants 15 points of Mages Guild Reputation. You must already be a member of the Mages Guild to use this item, and cannot use it if your Mages Guild Rank is 10.
When used, this citation grants 70 points of Fighters Guild Reputation. You must already be a member of the Fighters Guild to use this item, and cannot use it if your Fighters Guild Rank is 10.
When used, this citation grants 15 points of Undaunted Reputation. You must already be a member of the Undaunted to use this item, and cannot use it if your Undaunted Rank is 10.

When used, this citation grants 5 points of Dark Brotherhood Reputation. You must already be a member of the Dark Brotherhood to use this item, and you cannot use it if your Dark Brotherhood Rank is 12.
When used, this citation grants 5 points of Thieves Guild Reputation. You must already be a member of the Thieves Guild to use this item, and cannot use it if your Thieves Guild Rank is 12.
When used, this commendation advances your Companion to the next Fighters Guild skill rank, up to rank 10. This consumable can be used only by players level 10 and above.
